name: LightSync Pro – Connect & Sync Cloud Assets | Lightroom, Canva, Figma, Dropbox & Shutterstock
author: lightsyncpro

sections.description:
LightSync Pro creates a cloud-to-CMS image pipeline for WordPress and Shopify.

Connect your creative tools, browse your cloud content inside WordPress, and sync images without downloading, renaming, or re-uploading anything — to WordPress and Shopify simultaneously. When a source image changes, simply re-sync to update it in place — without breaking attachment IDs, layouts, or product images.

Whether you’re a photographer publishing from Lightroom, a designer working in Canva or Figma, or a Shopify merchant managing product images — LightSync Pro eliminates the repetitive download-upload cycle with automatic compression and optional AI image generation.

No exports. No duplicate uploads. No broken links.

How It Works

  1. Connect — Authorize Lightroom, Canva, Figma, Dropbox, Shutterstock, or OpenRouter (AI) via secure OAuth
  2. Browse — View albums, designs, files, folders, licensed images, or generate AI images directly inside WordPress
  3. Choose Destination — Sync to WordPress, Shopify, or both simultaneously
  4. Sync — Images are optimized, compressed, and added to your Media Library or Shopify Files

All sources sync to both WordPress and Shopify in the free version — no upgrade required for multi-destination sync.

Why LightSync Pro Is Different

  • No manual downloads from Canva, Lightroom, or Dropbox
  • No duplicate uploads to WordPress or Shopify
  • No broken image links when updating hero or product images
  • No developer API keys required
  • Replace images in place without changing attachment IDs
  • Update once, sync everywhere

Supported Sources

  • Adobe Lightroom — Browse albums, select photos, choose rendition sizes, and sync with version history
  • Canva — Browse designs and sync individual pages as images
  • Figma — Browse teams, projects, and files; sync individual frames as images
  • Dropbox — Browse folders, preview images, and sync files directly
  • Shutterstock — Sync images you’ve already licensed with your Shutterstock subscription — no re-downloading required
  • AI Image Generation — Generate images using 400+ AI models via OpenRouter (Flux, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Gemini, and more), then compress and sync directly to WordPress or Shopify

Sync Destinations

  • WordPress Media Library — Images sync as standard attachments, ready for posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and galleries
  • Shopify Files — Sync images directly to your Shopify store’s Files library for products, collections, and themes

Key Features

  • Cloud-Native OAuth — Secure broker-based authentication handles API credentials. No developer keys required.
  • Non-Destructive Updates — Re-sync an image and the existing attachment updates in place. All posts and products using it reflect the change automatically.
  • Version History — Track changes and roll back to previous versions of AI-generated images.
  • AI Image Generation — Generate images using 400+ AI models including Flux, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, and Gemini via OpenRouter.
  • Shopify Integration — Sync images from any source to Shopify Files.
  • WebP Compression — Automatic image optimization on sync improves page speed and reduces bandwidth usage.
  • Background Sync — Large batches process in the background so you can continue working.
  • Activity Feed — Complete sync history with timestamps and details.
  • Weekly Digest — Email summary of sync activity for your team.
  • SEO-Friendly Custom Naming — Apply naming patterns and custom alt text rules across synced images.
  • Optimization Analytics — Track compression savings and image performance.

Who Is This For?

  • Photographers publishing Lightroom portfolios to WordPress
  • Designers moving Canva or Figma visuals to their website
  • Stock image subscribers syncing licensed Shutterstock images
  • Shopify merchants managing product images across platforms
  • Content creators generating AI images inside WordPress
  • Agencies managing client sites with cloud-based creative assets
  • Content teams eliminating repetitive download-upload workflows

Plans & Upgrades

The free plugin connects 1 WordPress site with full manual sync, all listed sources, AI image generation, Shopify integration, and WebP compression.

Two paid tiers add automation, AI intelligence, and team licensing. Learn more at lightsyncpro.com/pricing.

Pro+ — adds to the free plan:

  • Auto-Sync Scheduling — Keep albums and folders in sync automatically without manual intervention
  • AI Assistant (MCP) — Claude-powered sync assistant built directly into your WordPress dashboard
  • Library Mode — Unified, filterable, searchable grid of all your assets across every connected source
  • Task Builder — Build custom sync rules that run on a schedule directly from your dashboard
  • Hero Picker — AI ranks your images for your specific use case so the best asset always leads
  • Auto Alt Text — AI-generated alt text for every synced image, improving accessibility and SEO automatically
  • A/B Image Testing — Test image variants and track which performs better
  • Filter by AI Scores — Sort and filter your Media Library by AI performance ratings
  • Performance Analytics — Track sync activity and image performance over time
  • Google Search Console Integration — Sync decisions informed by real search data
  • Chrome Extension — Sync directly from Lightroom via browser without leaving your workflow
  • AVIF Compression — Next-generation image optimization beyond WebP for even smaller file sizes
  • Email Support — Direct email access to the development team

Agency — adds to Pro+:

  • 5 Site Licenses — Each license works independently
  • Priority Support — Faster response times
  • Built for: web design agencies, freelancers managing multiple clients, multi-site portfolio owners, and marketing teams

Need to sync to HubSpot, Contentful, or Webflow? or distribute to multiple sites at once?

Syncific is the standalone platform that adds CMS destinations beyond WordPress and Shopify — same broker architecture, more destinations. Sync once from any source, fan out to unlimited sites simultaneously.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the lightsyncpro folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Open LightSync Pro in the admin sidebar
  4. Connect your first source (Lightroom, Canva, Figma, Dropbox, Shutterstock, or OpenRouter for AI)
  5. Optionally connect Shopify under Sync Destinations
  6. Browse cloud content or generate AI images and click Sync

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Account with at least one supported platform
  • Shopify store (optional)
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys?

No. Secure OAuth authentication is handled through the LightSync broker.

What happens when I edit an image in Lightroom, Canva, or Figma?

Re-sync it. The existing WordPress attachment updates in place without changing the attachment ID or breaking layout references.

Can I sync to both WordPress and Shopify at the same time?

Yes. Choose “Both” as your sync destination.

Where are my images stored?

Images are stored locally in your WordPress Media Library or Shopify Files library. LightSync Pro does not store your images on its servers — the broker only handles authentication and sync coordination.

Does syncing slow down my site?

No. Images are stored locally in your Media Library and optimized with WebP compression.

How does AI image generation work?

Connect OpenRouter, enter a prompt, choose from 400+ AI models, and generate images directly in WordPress. Generated images sync just like cloud sources.

How does Shutterstock sync work?

LightSync Pro syncs images you’ve already licensed. It does not purchase new licenses.

What’s the difference between LightSync Pro and Syncific?

LightSync Pro is a WordPress plugin. Syncific is a standalone platform that adds destinations beyond WordPress and Shopify (HubSpot, Contentful, Webflow). Both are built on the same broker architecture.
